transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because... lately, I'll get off a long shift at the shop, and I just end up eating way more than I ever planned to. Like, I'll have a full fast-food meal, a bunch of snacks, and just whatever else is sitting in the fridge. And I do it all in one sitting. It's kind of getting out of hand, so I figured I should come in and talk to somebody about it.
After eating like this, do you ever do anything to try to compensate or prevent weight gain, such as making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or exercising intensely?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes after I eat like that, I... I'll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. Or, you know, I'll take laxatives. I just get really scared of what all that food is going to do to my body, so I feel like I have to do something to get rid of it.
Could you share your current height and weight with me?
I'm not exactly sure what my current weight is. I haven't stepped on a scale in a while. As for my height, I'm about 5'10".
Around what did you weigh the last time you checked?

I honestly couldn't tell you. It's been... well, it's been a really long time since I actually stepped on one and looked at the number. I just try to avoid scales altogether, to be honest, so I really don't have a good guess to give you.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don't really think so. Like I said, I don't step on a scale, so I can't say for sure... but my work clothes still fit about the same. I haven't noticed any big drop or anything like that.
On average, how many times a week does this happen?

I'd say most weeks I have at least one night where I eat like that. And then... well, I try to make up for it afterwards. I'll either make myself throw up, take some laxatives, skip meals the next day, or just work out extra hard. It's been going on like this for several months now.
Would you say you have an intense fear of becoming fat?

Yeah, I would. I mean, even if my work pants feel a little looser, if I do happen to check the scale and it's up even just a pound... I just feel like I'm getting fat. It makes me start worrying that I'm going to completely lose control of my whole body. So yeah, it's definitely something I'm afraid of.
